A figure is a fenced code block with the language
. In AFFiNE it shows as a code block, which is harmless.
turns it into an interactive widget in the OpenSentience theme. Use
at most one or two per chapter
, and only where stepping or toggling teaches something that prose can't. Every string is plain text (no Markdown inside JSON).
: a sequence you step through (Play / Next / Back)
